scene: A recreational rowboat on a tranquil mountain lake in clear late-morning daylight. She sits firmly on a wooden rowing bench, each hand holding a separate wooden oar handle at natural waist height, hands separated in frame. Lake ripples and blue mountain reflections; face turned a little toward the camera with amusement, one traveler.
outfit: A sleeveless deep-green zip-front crop top, tan hiking shorts and practical deck shoes, a tiny gold geometric pendant. Bare arms and midriff, ordinary recreational travel clothes, no armor.
